main_text.l: dari curavi,ubi ne verbulo qvidem ipsum appetii; in eas tamen insurgit famam-
qve meam dilacerat. Tacitus hæc & le-
go & ab aliis audio & tacere semper de-
bus caput meum coronant, sunt ejusmo-
di; me vocant belluam insanam, rabie
raqve alia non dissimilia; Cum igitur
his hominibus, licet in eorum libro
judicavi, ne de simili materia scribens,
Hæc paucis, mi Buxtorfiut[?] scias qvo-ties,

page.notes: Line 25 "Buxtorfiut": the word space between "Buxtorfi" and "ut" is unclear in the scan, so it is marked [?]. The first word of the page is a continuation from the previous page.
